note: Unknown (not visible) is never read as off or safe.
answer:
The default repository permission of acme-legacy is unknown (not visible): the token is not an org owner on acme-legacy, so gop could not read it. That is not the same as off.

check_answerable said no for `org:acme-legacy`, so I can't give a verdict. Granting org owner access on acme-legacy (through the IdP, SAML is enforced) would make it visible.
